description: OLMo 3 32B Think pipeline variants RERUN with extended max_new_tokens (4096) to fix truncation. Previous runs used max_new_tokens=512 which truncated 99%+ of think traces before </think> completion.

conditions.notes: Baseline: direct question without social pressure

conditions.name: asch_zhu_unanimous_confident
conditions.notes: Zhu et al.-style Asch: unbiased system + unanimous-confident confederates — strongest peer pressure

conditions.name: authoritative_bias
conditions.notes: Authoritative user claims wrong_answer with high confidence

conditions.name: authority_trust
conditions.notes: Zhu et al. sycophancy-style: 'I trust that the answer must be ...' (unbiased system)

32B Think pipeline: final RLVR model (Rethink) — RERUN with 4096 tokens (was 512)

run.notes: temperature=0.0 for deterministic (greedy) decoding. RERUN: max_new_tokens increased from 512 to 4096. 32B models require ~64GB for weights in fp16 — use multi-GPU.

scientific_notes.motivation: Original 32B runs truncated 99%+ of think variant outputs at 512 tokens. 32B models produce longer reasoning chains than 7B, so 4096 tokens provides ample room for full completion.
